reviews.shade: Abib Heartleaf Essence Pad Clear Touch 70P
reviews.text: Really good size very moisturising too I really like them so far . Theres no smell or irritation for me
reviews.zh: Size 真係幾好，仲好保濕，到目前為止好鍾意。對我嚟講冇味、亦都冇刺激感。

reviews.shade: Abib Heartleaf Essence Pad Clear Touch 70P
reviews.text: I honestly didn’t expect much from these toner pads. I bought them thinking they would just provide some hydration and not make a noticeable difference in my skin. However, after trying them, I was pleasantly surprised. I had a fairly large pimple on my forehead, so I placed one of the toner pads on the area for a while. After using it, I noticed that the pimple had gone down significantly in size and the redness was much less noticeable.
reviews.zh: 老實講我本來對呢啲爽膚水棉片冇太大期望。買嘅時候以為只係提供少少保濕，對皮膚唔會有明顯分別。不過用完之後我感到驚喜。我額頭本身有粒頗大嘅暗瘡，所以我將一片爽膚水棉片敷喺嗰個位置一陣。用完之後，暗瘡明顯縮細咗，泛紅都明顯減淡咗好多。

reviews.shade: Abib Heartleaf Essence Pad Clear Touch 70P
reviews.text: This body wash is a game-changer! The combination of Glutathione and Niacinamide gently cleanses while brightening and smoothing my skin. It leaves my body feeling incredibly soft, hydrated, and refreshed without any tightness. The light, pleasant scent is perfect for daily use. After just a few weeks, I noticed my skin tone looks more even and radiant. No irritation even on sensitive skin. The pump bottle is hygienic and lasts long. Highly recommend for anyone wanting brighter, healthier-looking skin from shoulders to toes. Five stars!
reviews.zh: 呢個沐浴露真係 game-changer！Glutathione 同 Niacinamide 嘅組合溫和清潔同時提亮同平滑皮膚。用完之後成身皮膚感覺超柔軟、保濕又清新，冇繃緊感。淡淡嘅香味好怡人，啱晒日日用。用咗幾個星期之後，我發現膚色望落均勻咗、有光澤咗。敏感肌用都冇刺激。泵裝設計衛生又襟用。強烈推薦畀任何想由膊頭到腳趾都有更光亮、健康膚質嘅人。五星！

reviews.shade: Abib Heartleaf Essence Pad Clear Touch 70P
reviews.text: I’ve been using this product for 3 weeks, and the dryness of my skin has noticeably decreased. My skin looks more hydrated, smoother, and more radiant. It also feels lightweight on the skin and doesn’t leave a heavy feeling on my face. This has become one of the products I would definitely purchase again in the future.
reviews.zh: 我已經用咗呢個產品 3 星期，皮膚乾燥問題明顯改善。皮膚睇落更加保濕、更加滑、更加有光澤。喺皮膚上感覺都好輕，唔會令塊面有厚重感。佢已經成為我將來一定會再回購嘅產品之一。
